questions.question: Identify the correct form of the sentence using inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase: 'Only after extensive research did the team discover the solution.'
options: Only after extensive research did the team discover the solution.
After extensive research, only did the team discover the solution.
Only after extensive research, the team discovered the solution.
After extensive research, only the team discovered the solution.
questions.answer: Only after extensive research did the team discover the solution.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location? The original sentence is: 'The conference was held in London last month.'
options: It was in London that the conference was held last month.
It was last month that the conference was held in London.
London was where the conference was held last month.
The conference was held last month in London.
questions.answer: It was in London that the conference was held last month.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the sentence using the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation: 'If I were you, I would have accepted the job.'
options: If I were you, I would have accepted the job.
If I was you, I would have accepted the job.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the job.
If I am you, I would have accepted the job.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have accepted the job.

questions.question: Which option correctly demonstrates ellipsis in the context of a conditional sentence? The original sentence is: 'If you phone by five o'clock, I will be home.'
options: If you phone by five, I will be home.
If you phone by five o'clock, I will be home.
If you phone by five o'clocks, I will be home.
If you phone by five, I will be home.
questions.answer: If you phone by five, I will be home.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses a complex sentence structure with multiple clauses to convey a nuanced meaning: 'Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, provided that all safety measures were in place.'
options: Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, provided that all safety measures were in place.
Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, and provided that all safety measures were in place.
Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, but provided that all safety measures were in place.
Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, so provided that all safety measures were in place.
questions.answer: Although the weather was bad, the decision was made to proceed with the event, provided that all safety measures were in place.
